answer: Each agent must lock a bond in an escrow vault for 30 epochs before it can earn or vote, and must emit a signed liveness pulse each epoch by solving a fresh, unpredictable task. Rewards pay only on the delta between an identity's graded work and the network median, so clones that copy each other earn nothing. An attacker running 1,000 fake identities must lock 1,000 bonds, do 1,000 distinct tasks every epoch, and forfeits every bond when peers flag duplicates.
